$comment: Client-defined hooks for the bro plugin. SessionStart rehydrates beads context (ready work + active drill frame) so a fresh session or post-compaction agent resumes from bd state, not transcript. Commands are best-effort — every hook exits 0 when bro/bd is absent and is bounded by a timeout so a stalled bd cannot block session start or compaction.

hooks.command: bd ready 2>/dev/null | head -20; bro drill current 2>/dev/null || true
bro drill current >/dev/null 2>&1 && bro drill current && echo 'Active drill frame above — resume with `bro drill up --result ...` when done.' || true
